items.label: Smart Half Round Design Plant Support
items.value: half round design make the garden stakes easy to fit around the plants, just attach 2pcs together to support your plant. Effective at supporting plants up to 3 foot when using these plant plant stakes for outdoor plants.

items.label: Wide Applications Plant Stake
items.value: the peony cages and supports are 25 cm/10 inch wide, 40 cm/15.8 inch high, can fit most bushy plants like hydrangeas, roses, peonies, salvias, cone flowers, etc. tomato plants and vine plants like cherry tomato, etc. Also can be used as border to keep pathways open in your garden.

items.label: Sturdy material and powder coating
items.value: HiGift half round plant cage are made of sturdy iron wire in 4mm diameter with powder coating, it is better than others that in cheap plastic coated. the powder coating on this plant wire support will last long time even using this plant supports for outdoor plants under sun and rain.

items.label: Natural Appearance
items.value: The plant support garden stakes in dark green help it to blend into green plants. You can use this peony cage for peony plant indoor and outdoor.

items.label: Package includes
items.value: 8 Pack Half Round Garden Plant Support (10" Wide x 15.8" High)

items.label: Recommended Uses for Product
items.value: Supporting various plants such as tomatoes, hydrangeas, roses, peonies, salvias, cone flowers, and cherry tomatoes
